title: Chapter 1094
paragraphs: Chapter 1094
Episode 256. Morganil (3)
Pssssss...!
Morganil's body was decomposing and scattering into particles. Soon, she became a handful of powder, remaining under Chiron's gaze.
The expedition to subjugate the five kings of the Black Sea.

It was the moment that the lifelong cherished wish of Runcandel, of Chiron, which had continued for decades, had finally met its end. The expedition members, including Khan who was nearby, trembled and shed tears as soon as they confirmed Morganil's death.
It had been a journey so painful that even those strong former Black Knights could not hold back their tears. Luna's eyes also grew hot as she supported the approaching expedition members.
However, Chiron only looked down at the powder that was once Morganil with an emotionless gaze. The elation he had felt when he was certain he could cut her down had disappeared as if it were a lie.
Is this really the end?
Rather, that thought would not leave Chiron's mind. From the day he began the Black Sea expedition, he had never once imagined that Morganil would meet such a hollow end.
“...Even if this is not the end, there is nothing we can do for now.”
“Father?”
“The Black Sea expedition is hereby concluded.”
Chiron ruffled Luna's hair and checked the condition of the expedition members. It was a miracle that everyone had survived.
“Youngest.”
“Yes, Father.”
“Hey, you just scolded me for calling you Father, but you're fine with the youngest.”
“Is the mission not over now, Luna?”
“Well, that's true.”

Although it was a well-known fact that Chiron had overcome his demonic transformation, seeing him dote on Luna in person like this gave Jin a strange feeling. Of course, it was a strange feeling in a good way.
“Is there a medical facility included in the fleet you brought?”
“We have facilities that are better than the Holy Kingdom's. I will have the expedition members brought up immediately.”
“Excellent. Vahn, did you bring any liquor?”
“Of course, I brought cups too. Unlike someone who held out their dirty gauntlet.”
“You really are more narrow-minded than you look.”
Time was of the essence.

Just because they had subjugated Morganil did not mean it was a time to happily drink liquor. However, Jin did not stop the brothers from disembarking from the ship with the gem wine. Because Chiron was not just speaking out of sentimentality.
“We have to wait for the changes in the Black Sea for a while anyway, so let's have a light drink and catch up. Sit, Luna, Jin. You must have a lot to talk about.”
The changes in the Black Sea.
As he said, the moment Jin and Luna sat down, the scenery of the area suddenly began to change.
First, trees were suddenly shooting up in all directions. Not the thorny trees that held the Black Sea's unique toxic fluid, but bright yellow trees, like the autumn leaves of a ginkgo tree.
“It is the life force that had been suppressed by the five kings of the Black Sea until now, exploding. There is no need to be so surprised.”
“It's too beautiful to not be surprised, Chiron. This is like... an entire hidden world is blooming, isn't it.”
The sound of flowing water could be heard from somewhere, and the air, which had been murky with shadow energy until just a moment ago, became unspeakably fresh.

Between the trees that had already grown to a height of ten steps, small insects of unknown names were making pleasant chirping sounds, and all sorts of blue and red flowers and grasses were soaking the earth.
All those changes took place before Chiron even raised his first cup. Even after they had each taken a sip of the gem wine, the changes were still advancing towards the distant horizon.
“Is this really the Black Sea...? Hah, I've lived for three thousand years, but this is really the first time I've seen something like this.”
“The entire Black Sea is not changing like this, Sir Murakan.”
“Is that so? Hmm, by the way, Chiron, this is a bit uncomfortable. The kid is on informal terms with me, so you should just do the same.”
“Alright. Give me a cup.”
“Uh, sure.”

To the eyes of the coalition members on standby in the fleet, the changes in the Black Sea were even more apparent. The bright yellow trees that had bloomed in the Black Sea were continuing in a single direction, as if forming a path.
“While tracking and facing Morganil.”
The moment Chiron opened his mouth, everyone sitting beside him focused on him.
“I was aware of the fact that some great change had occurred outside. Because I felt a power even greater than the day the Plutonians' Battle God had awoken. And it wasn't just one, but two.”
The leader of the Demon Army, Kelliark Zipfel, and Malugia. Chiron had recognized their power the moment they revealed themselves in the mortal world.
“That power belongs to an ego of the Sun God named Malugia and a man named Kelliark Zipfel, Father.”
“A Kelliark Zipfel from another world, I see.”
“Did you perhaps know about the multiple worlds from before?”
“No, I only inferred it recently through the words that Morganil had said. Furthermore, it is impossible for the Kelliark Zipfel that I knew, and that you all knew, to become like that.”
The multiple worlds; Chiron had vaguely grasped the truth through a few words that Morganil had said.
-[I see now, Chiron Runcandel. The you of this place is special. This is the only world where my brothers and I have met such a result.]
-[In no other place did you bind my brothers and me together as one. What is it that makes you continue to fight?]
-[The reason I have decided to die by your hand now is merely to not violate that truth. I pray that victory is before you, my old friend.]
The words that Morganil had said during the chase, and at her final moment.
Chiron mulled over her last words again. 'If she had not decided to die' was no different from saying that Morganil could have survived even at this point.
Jin explained the truth of the multiple worlds and the horrific events that had recently occurred in the world to Chiron in detail for a while.

“...So that is what happened. In that case, does Morganil's last will mean that she let me win because I am needed in this world? In any case, Morganil too, like the Witch, must have become aware of the multiple worlds from the moment a certain branch point was passed.”
If Kelliark Zipfel were to deal with this world and Malugia, the 'equal death' that Morganil spoke of would disappear from all dimensions.
Because Kelliark Zipfel would become an eternal and immortal being at that moment. No one would be left in any dimension to resist him.
“Hmm, if that's what it means, didn't Morganil decide to stand on the side of this world?”
“It could be seen that way, Murakan.”

“Hey, if she was going to side with us anyway, she should have just formed an alliance and fought with us like that Orgal fellow. Why did she have to get stabbed and die? We need every hand we can get. And if that was her state even after she deliberately let herself die, doesn't that mean she was originally even stronger than that?”
“Sir Murakan, that is a rather fresh approach.”
“Chiron, am I wrong?”
“No, you are right. However, in my opinion, the reason Morganil died is likely because of the arrangement that Lord Solderet left behind.”
“...An arrangement, you say?”
“Morganil seems to want us to reach that subspace.”
Chiron put down his cup and pointed forward with his finger.
While the sight of the Black Sea, still changing and being colored in various hues, could be seen, the yellow trees that continued in one direction like a path were newly catching their eye.
It was a path, so obvious that one could tell even from their seated position.
“Youngest.”
“Yes, Father.”

“I can be certain. What exists at the end of that path is the subspace that Lokia Ganesto is said to have created. From what I have faced so far, that being was not merely a fragment of the Origin Stone.”
“If she is not a fragment of the Origin Stone... do you mean that Morganil existed even before the Origin Stone was destroyed?”

“Yes. Gliek, Kial, S, Nirghand. I had thought that the kings of the Black Sea were all born at the same time, but Morganil was not. Morganil is a kind of great primordial will. She had wandered the world for a long time and had dwelled within the Origin Stone the moment it was born.”
“Do you mean she existed from the beginning, like the Sun God?”

“That much I do not know, Vahn. However, since Morganil was safeguarding the arrangement that Lord Solderet left behind, she must be related to him in some way. That is why she has opened the path for us now. What do you think is inside there?”
“Honestly, I do not know well.”
“Whatever it is, you must have come to the Black Sea because you could no longer not open it.”
“Yes, Father. We were that devoid of hope.”
“We must hope that Lord Solderet has not betrayed us.”
The moment Chiron said that, Focal descended from the flagship Sarah.
[Chiron Runcandel.]
“Ah, my greetings are late, Lord Focal.”

[The scenery I have seen today, I can say it was one of the most beautiful sights since I created this world. I wish to express my gratitude for that, but first, I thought I must show this to you and Jin.]
Focal was holding a box that looked like a small coffin.
It was the box in which Temar's left arm was stored. When she opened the box, the sight of Temar's left arm, wrapped in an intense violet light, could be seen.
Barisada, which was hanging on Chiron's waist, was vibrating in reaction to that light.

[From what I have gleaned, the body of Temar and Barisada. It seems those two elements are the essential conditions to enter Solderet's arrangement. However, there is one problem. As you can see, a curse is currently applied to Temar's left arm.]
The curse left by Airan Vermont, of the Melka tribe, when he took Temar's body.
[With this curse, the body of Temar will not be able to perform its role as an authentication tool to enter the subspace.]
“Fortunately, it is a problem that this one can solve.”
It was Ameris, who had descended with Focal.
“It was a good thing I followed. I somehow felt there would be a moment when some super-ancient knowledge would be needed.”
Currently, the only people who could reverse and undo the curse of the Melka tribe were Lokia Ganesto and Ameris.
“Lady Ameris. How much time would be needed to undo the curse?”
“Even at the fastest, it will take five days.”
“Will it take the same amount of time even if we return to Tikan and work on it?”
“Yes. And it is not as if Focal and Silkia can easily open a dimensional gate from the Black Sea to the mortal world, so for now, wait.”

As she had said, just as the environment of the Black Sea had suddenly changed, Focal and Silkia also needed various adjustments to open a dimensional gate back to the mortal world. Although Morganil was dead, her influence had not all disappeared.
“Understood.”
